messages:
Alex Chen: heads up — AcmeMedia reporting huge token/billing spikes + 5xxs. They sent traces: requests are getting handled in both us-west-2 and eu-west-1 within the same user session. Think SDK is hopping regions. Anyone seen this pattern?
SupportBot: Ticket #67821 created: https://redwood.support/t/67821 — assigned to @Customer Ops. Auto-alert: routing-fanout detected.
Maria Gomez: can you paste a minimal repro or client logs? need headers and SDK config. sounds like hedged requests + low timeout to me.
Alex Chen: attaching simplified client log snippet and config (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-12T15:01:02Z] request-id=abcd-1234 endpoint=https://api.redwood.ai region=us-west-2
sdk.config = {
  "endpoints": ["https://api.redwood.ai/us-west-2","https://api.redwood.ai/eu-west-1"],
  "hedged_requests": true,
  "hedged_max_attempts": 2,
  "hedged_delay_ms": 50,
  "timeout_ms": 200,
  "backoff": "rand_jitter"
}
```
Alex Chen: note: client is explicit about multi-region endpoints (they used our multi-region bootstrap) and they didn't set affinity.
Jay Patel: looks classic — hedged_delay 50ms + timeout 200ms means the second leg fires very early and DNS round-robin + regional LB picks a different region. Both RPCs finish sometimes -> double token accounting and cross-region latency for the app.
Priya Shah: reproduction steps I used on my laptop: 1) point SDK to two endpoints with round-robin DNS, 2) enable hedging with delay 40-60ms, 3) throttle one region to add slight latency (~100ms). Result: ~30% of requests get served by the slower region but both legs recorded as billable.
Maria Gomez: customer also saw 502/504 spikes when the slower leg responded late. This explains 5xx + billing.
Jay Patel: short-term mitigation: tell customer to set `hedged_requests=false` or bump `timeout_ms` to >=500ms and `hedged_delay_ms` >=200ms. Better: enable region affinity header `X-Redwood-Affinity: region=us-west-2` so hedges prefer same region for fallbacks.
Alex Chen: can we add a server-side guard? e.g., if two identical request-ids hit different regions within X ms, dedupe billing/response?
EngRuntime Bot: flagged to eng-runtime team. @Jay @Priya can you open a runbook? We should also consider changing SDK defaults.
Jay Patel: will open PR to change SDK default from hedged=true to hedged=false and add guidance in devex docs. Proposal: hedged default only for single-region endpoints or when affinity mode=off explicitly.
Priya Shah: I'll add a quick KB for support to give customers (repro steps + 2 config options).
Customer Ops: notifying AcmeMedia with the mitigation steps (disable hedges / increase timeout / set affinity). They asked for ETA on SDK patch.
Alex Chen: thanks — marking thread for follow-up. cc @EngRuntime Bot please paste PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: note for postmortem: call out double-billing risk when hedging crosses region boundaries. small docs blurb could prevent repeats. :memo:
SupportBot: Ticket #67821 updated: customer notified, workaround applied.
